one_liner: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scores 33.3 points per 36 minutes on 53.5 percent from the field and 88.4 percent from the line.
three_things: The scoring rate of 33.3 points per 36 minutes comes on unusually clean efficiency for a guard: 53.5 percent from the field.
He is reliable at the stripe, converting 88.4 percent of free throws.
Durability shows up too: 218 games across the three-season window, among the highest game counts in this pack.
context_note: Numbers are per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not a full career; the manifest is descriptive_only, with no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor. High field-goal percentage for a guard often reflects a mid-range and rim-heavy diet, which the raw rate does not separate.
